faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery TDV6 use?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery TDV6 uses a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, coded TDV6, fitted across the D3 (L319, 2004–2009) and D4 (L319 facelift, 2009–2016) generations.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery TDV6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery TDV6?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your TDV6 engine spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV6 Discovery engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery TDV6 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery TDV6 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery TDV6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery TDV6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
